verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented API (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9) that enables creating sessions programmatically on behalf of users, explicitly for integrating into applications and automating workflows — a core headless/CI use case. It also supports scheduling recurring tasks via MCP (devin-docs-17) and has a CLI (devin-probe-4) for scriptable interaction. Missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions integration), no independent/hands-on confirmation of headless automation working reliably in production CI.
